text:
Jordan: Hey team — first week question: I can't find the 'Platform Playbook' template in Notion and when I try to create a page under /docs the 'Team' option isn't available. Who should I ping for editor access?
Maya R.: Welcome! Did you receive the Redwood Docs invite email? Check spam first. Which email did you sign up with?
Jordan: I used jordan+redwood@gmail.com. I can view most pages but the template duplicate button is greyed out and I only have 'Can view'.
Samir V.: Sounds like a space-level permission. You need Editor on the Platform space to duplicate org templates. Either @docs-bot can grant it or someone from Docs/DevEx can send an invite.
Jordan: How do I trigger docs-bot? I can't find it in my DMs.
Maya R.: Docs-bot lives in #devex. You can run this in the channel: `@docs-bot grant jordan+redwood@gmail.com editor platform` — or use the self-serve form: https://redwood.example.com/docs-access (choose 'Editor' + 'Platform').
Jordan: I tried duplicating this template: https://notion.so/redwood/Platform-Playbook-Template but the duplicate dialog only shows my personal workspace.
Alex H.: That's the org duplication block. Quick workaround: if you need just one template copy, @Samir or I can duplicate it to the Platform space for you and then you can edit.
Samir V.: I pulled the request. @docs-bot: `grant jordan+redwood@gmail.com editor platform`
Docs-bot: Invitation sent to jordan+redwood@gmail.com for role 'Editor' on space 'Platform'. :tada:
Jordan: Got the invite email and accepted — I can duplicate now. Huge thanks! :pray:
Maya R.: For future new hires: 1) get Editor on your team space 2) favorite the main playbooks 3) make a copy of the onboarding checklist. I'll paste the short checklist in #new-hires later.
Jordan: One more quick q — where are naming conventions and page templates documented?
Maya R.: There's a tiny doc at /docs > Standards > Page Conventions. If you can't find it, DM me and I'll share a direct link.
Jordan: Found it, and I added the Platform Playbook to Favorites. Thread solved, thanks everyone!
Samir V.: Pro tip: if duplication still fails, check this two-line snippet for direct copy-in-place:
```
Open template page -> ••• menu -> Duplicate -> select 'Redwood' workspace -> choose 'Platform' space
```
Alex H.: Also note: some org templates are restricted for security/legal reasons — if duplication is blocked, please raise a Docs request and include the page URL and purpose.
Jordan: Will do. Appreciate the help! :smile:
